subject: Combine design matrix from 2 effects in one hyperpar

messages.author: da63f9ca4e626114
messages.subject: Combine design matrix from 2 effects in one hyperpar
parts:
Dear INLA gorup user,
I try reproduce exactly the same model that is demonstrated in Sommer Packager.
In the sommer, is possible to use the function overlay that produces a design matrix combined between to variables, in this case, femalef and malef, in this example the model are 'iid' in INLA enviromental.
My question are:
1)  it possible input direct in INLA model the design matrix Zm?
2) We have another way to fit this model in INLA? 
Thanks 

# source: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sommer/vignettes/v3.sommer.qg.pdf
#code:
data("DT_halfdiallel") 
DT<-DT_halfdiallel head(DT) 
DT$femalef<-as.factor(DT$female)
 DT$malef<-as.factor(DT$male) 
DT$genof<-as.factor(DT$geno) 
####model using overlay
modh<-mmec(sugar~1, random=~vsc(isc(overlay(femalef,malef))) +genof,nIters=3, data=DT,verbose=FALSE) 
summary(modh)$varcomp

# Combined matrix
Zm <- with(DT,overlay(femalef,malef))
